security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's rmw_mip64 makes STIP read-only in mip (or rmw_mvip64 strips STIP from sip's mip alias) based solely on ext_sstc==true, without also checking that menvcfg.STCE==1. When STCE=0 but sstc is implemented, the spec requires STIP to be writable by M-mode in mip and to alias into sip, so that M-mode firmware (OpenSBI) can deliver timer interrupts to S-mode via the legacy STIP-write mechanism. Omitting the STCE check permanently locks STIP read-only, blocking the fallback timer interrupt path.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: if.*ext_sstc.*mask.*~MIP_STIP without a preceding or combined get_field.*menvcfg.*MENVCFG_STCE check in rmw_mip64 or rmw_mvip64; or a riscv_timer_write_timecmp path that drives STIP based on stimecmp comparison without first checking menvcfg.STCE
security_spec.summary: STIP read-only in mip/sip must be gated on menvcfg.STCE==1, not merely on ext_sstc presence; otherwise guest OS timer interrupts are lost when firmware disables STCE and falls back to the legacy M-mode STIP-write delivery path
